provenance.justification: servo/stylo publishes no copy of the MPL at that commit: a recursive tree scan finds only malloc_size_of/LICENSE-{APACHE,MIT} and servo_arc/LICENSE-{APACHE,MIT} (Apache/MIT, for those crates) and style/properties/vendored_python/markupsafe/LICENSE.txt. README.md at that commit states "Stylo is licensed under MPL 2.0", and every selectors source file carries Mozilla’s Exhibit A header pointing at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/. The text is therefore taken from the Servo Project’s own licence file in servo/servo, the primary repository of the same GitHub organisation and the project named in the crate’s authors field, pinned to the commit that last modified it. MPL-2.0 is a standard-form text with no copyright-holder field, so nothing is filled in on the owner’s behalf.
